boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Redlands
boards.description: Ten currently documented, under-21-safe food destinations in Redlands with late operating hours.

cards.title: Denny’s on Redlands Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 110 W Redlands Blvd · open 24 hours
cards.notes: Use this all-hours diner when you need a sit-down meal or takeout; confirm holiday service before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock diner option near downtown Redlands.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's lists its 110 W Redlands Blvd restaurant as open 24 hours and offers breakfast, lunch, dinner, and takeout.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists the restaurant open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Carl’s Jr. on Colton Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1205 W Colton Ave · open 24 hours
cards.notes: Choose the drive-thru or dining area for a late meal; use the location page to check service changes before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour fast-food stop on Colton Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Carl's Jr. lists its 1205 W Colton Ave Redlands location as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists every day as open 24 hours; it identifies drive-thru service.

cards.title: Jack in the Box on East Redlands Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 605 E Redlands Blvd · drive-thru until 3:30 a.m.
cards.notes: Plan this as a drive-thru stop after the lobby closes; check the day-specific schedule because Sunday through Wednesday end earlier.
cards.short_summary: A Redlands Boulevard drive-thru with especially late Thursday–Saturday service.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists drive-thru hours until 3:30 a.m. Thursday through Saturday at 605 E Redlands Blvd; lobby hours end at 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 605 E Redlands Blvd
cards.access_notes: Official page: drive-thru to 3:30 a.m. Thu–Sat; lobby to 10 p.m. daily. Sun–Wed drive-thru closes at 1 a.m.

cards.title: Del Taco on West Redlands Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 1624 W Redlands Blvd · until 2 a.m.
cards.notes: Use the posted counter or drive-thru hours for a late taco or burrito order, and recheck the location page for holiday exceptions.
cards.short_summary: A late-night Del Taco with 2 a.m. closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Del Taco lists 1624 W Redlands Blvd open until 2 a.m. daily, with a 7 a.m. Sunday opening and 6 a.m. other days.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists store and delivery hours ending at 2 a.m. every day.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West Colton
cards.subtitle: 1225 W Colton · drive-thru until midnight or 1 a.m.
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the late window, since dine-in ends earlier; Friday and Saturday offer the latest listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Colton Avenue drive-thru with midnight-or-later hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists its 1225 W Colton drive-thru open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru to midnight Sun–Thu and 1 a.m. Fri–Sat; dine-in hours are earlier.

cards.title: In-N-Out Burger in Redlands
cards.subtitle: 1301 W Redlands Blvd · until 1 or 1:30 a.m.
cards.notes: Make this a late drive-thru or counter stop and use the restaurant locator before leaving, especially around holidays or special closures.
cards.short_summary: A Redlands In-N-Out with late daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out's Redlands opening release states the restaurant is open daily until 1 a.m. and until 1:30 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official release states 10:30 a.m.–1 a.m. daily, extending to 1:30 a.m. Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on East Cypress Avenue
cards.subtitle: 450 E Cypress Ave · until midnight or 1 a.m.
cards.notes: Order for carryout or delivery using the location page; schedule pickup with the posted closing time in mind, as delivery hours can vary.
cards.short_summary: A carryout and delivery pizza option with late-weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists its 450 E Cypress Ave location open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant hours to midnight Sun–Thu and 1 a.m. Fri–Sat; delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: Fred’s Red Tacos at Redlands Public Market
cards.subtitle: 330 3rd St · until midnight or 1 a.m.
cards.notes: Head to the Redlands Public Market location for birria-inspired food, and check the venue’s current event or holiday schedule before you go.
cards.short_summary: A late taco counter located inside Redlands Public Market.
cards.evidence_claim: Fred's Red Tacos states that its 330 3rd St Redlands location is open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official FAQ lists 8 a.m.–midnight Sun–Thu and 8 a.m.–1 a.m. Fri–Sat.

cards.title: R Burgers on Alabama Street
cards.subtitle: 1280 Alabama St · until 11 p.m. or midnight
cards.notes: Use the Alabama Street location for a late meal; Friday and Saturday have the latest posted closing time, while other days end at 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A locally branded burger stop with midnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: R Burgers lists its Redlands location at 1280 Alabama St open until 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 5 a.m.–11 p.m. Sun–Thu and 5 a.m.–midnight Fri–Sat.

cards.title: Redlands Public Market
cards.subtitle: 330 3rd St · open until midnight Friday–Saturday
cards.notes: Use the shared market space for an early or late bite from its vendors; verify individual vendor availability and the market calendar before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A multi-vendor market that stays open late on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Redlands Public Market lists hours of 8 a.m.–10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 8 a.m.–midnight Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists market hours through midnight Friday and Saturday; individual eatery hours may differ.
